title: Admin review recommendations — DPA / 19AB Navigator
purpose: Help practice staff prepare for EOI conversations using navigator themes — never to rule on eligibility.
do: Read pathwayThemes and questionsForWmc before calling a candidate
Provide factual practice location details when asked for Services Australia paperwork
Point doctors back to official SA / Health links in resultJson.servicesAustraliaResources
Link navigator session to CareerApplication when EOI follows (careerApplicationId)
Document that WMC did not determine DPA/19AB outcomes in any notes
Escalate complex cases to the doctor’s own adviser / Services Australia — not practice interpretation
doNot: Tell a doctor they are eligible or ineligible for DPA or s19AB
Promise provider numbers, exemptions, or Medicare outcomes
Use navigator results as an automated reject/hire score
Store migration document copies unless a later formal onboarding process requires them under policy

reviewChecklist.label: Pathway themes noted for conversation prep
Practice location information pack ready if requested
If fellowship in_progress — check supervision capacity before encouraging start dates
If EOI received — link navigator session id on application
